6d9fbeb078f66c5d.description: COGNNA is redefining modern cybersecurity with Nexus, our Agentic AI SOC platform, and our Smart MDR services. We help organizations across the region and around the world cut alert noise, respond to incidents faster and stay compliant with frameworks such as SAMA, NCA, ISO 27001 and PCI DSS. Behind it all: AI-driven triage, deep automation and our elite 24/7 Guardians Team, delivering unified visibility and rapid threat containment across endpoint, cloud and network. We are looking for a motivated Security Engineer Intern to join our Security Engineering team. This intern position is centered on building, integrating, and operating the tools and platforms that power our security operations—connecting data sources, automating workflows, and strengthening how we detect, manage, and respond to risk. Responsibilities Stack & Data Integration: Support the integration and onboarding of new data sources, tools, and platforms into our security stack. Pipeline Maintenance: Help configure, tune, and maintain log collection, detection, and alerting pipelines across on-prem and cloud environments. Incident & Forensics Support: Assist in deploying and integrating tooling used for investigation, evidence collection, and forensic analysis during security incidents. Vulnerability Management: Support the rollout and integration of vulnerability scanning tools, and help track, prioritize, and report on findings across systems. Cloud Infrastructure: Contribute to securing and integrating tooling across cloud infrastructure, including identity, access, and configuration management. Scripting & Automation: Write scripts and automation to connect tools, reduce manual work, and improve data flow between security systems. R&D & Prototyping: Research and prototype new tools, integrations, or workflows to improve the team's detection, response, and risk management capabilities. Documentation: Prepare clear technical documentation and reports summarizing integrations, findings, and recommendations. Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed a degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field. Core Technical Knowledge: Solid understanding of networking, operating systems (Windows/Linux), and core security concepts. Scripting Skills: Familiarity with scripting or programming (e.g., Python, Bash, PowerShell) for automation and tool integration. API Interest: Interest in APIs and system integration—connecting different tools and platforms so data flows smoothly between them. Analytical Mindset: Strong analytical thinking, curiosity, and a genuine interest in security engineering. Communication: Good communication skills and ability to document technical work clearly. Bonus points Exposure to digital forensics and incident response (DFIR) concepts and open-source or commercial investigation tooling. Understanding of log management, detection engineering, or SIEM/SOC concepts. Awareness of vulnerability scanning and risk-based vulnerability management practices. Basic knowledge of public cloud platforms (e.g., Google Cloud, AWS, or Azure) and cloud security fundamentals. Hands-on mentorship from experienced security engineers. Real-world exposure to enterprise-grade security tools and how they integrate into a live security stack. Practical experience across tooling integration, cloud security, and security research. Opportunity to contribute to production security projects and build a strong security engineering portfolio.

Benefits and pay are determined at the local level and are not part of Boeing ******* payroll. Compensation will commensurate with experience and qualifications and in accordance with applicable Saudi Arabia law. Employment is subject to the candidate's ability to satisfy all Saudi Arabia labor and immigration formalities. Relocation assistance is not a negotiable benefit for this position; candidates must live in the immediate area or relocate at their own expense. The employer is not willing to sponsor applicants for employment visa status. Key Responsibilities Create, maintain, and advance customer relationships, developing an understanding of customer culture and business strategies. Interact with customers and internal partners through face-to-face/virtual meetings, phone calls, emails, and other media. Manage customer account health and provide customer support. Collaborate with customers to determine specific needs and recommend potential solutions, involving internal partners as needed. Develop, prepare, and deliver presentations to customers and internal organizations. Advise customers regarding the status, changes, or improvements of orders and follow up on account-related issues. Utilize multiple Boeing systems in a fast-paced environment. Respond to customer inquiries and provide information regarding Boeing products, services, processes, and operations. Respond to customer inquiries and facilitate delivery problem resolution. Enter, track, monitor, and coordinate customer material, delivery requirements, and returns for customer orders. Analyze customer spare parts requirement inquiries, facilitate responses, and resolve delivery problems. Monitor and share key performance metrics with customers and internal partners. Interface with customers and internal Boeing resources. Required Qualifications and Experience 1+ years of experience working in a supply chain-focused role. 6d1f03d0c91a4f13.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة دار الحماية لاجهزة السلامة عن فني ميكانيكي تمديدات صحية وتدفئة وغاز للانضمام إلى فريقها في المدينة المنورة، وتحديداً في ينبع. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإشراف على أعمال التمديدات وتشخيص الأعطال الميكانيكية، ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات. الهدف من الوظيفة يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية إعداد قوائم المواد والمعدات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز. كما يشمل الدور متابعة تنفيذ هذه الأعمال، بالإضافة إلى تشخيص أعطال المعدات الميكانيكية والإشراف على إصلاحها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد قوائم مفصلة ببنود القطع والمواد والمعدات الضرورية لتنفيذ مشاريع التمديدات الصحية، التدفئة المركزية، وشبكات الغاز. متابعة الإشراف على تنفيذ أعمال شبكات أنابيب التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة المركزية وشبكات الغاز لضمان الجودة والالتزام بالمواصفات. تشخيص الأعطال في المعدات الميكانيكية المختلفة ومتابعة عمليات الإصلاح لضمان استمرارية العمل. متابعة تنفيذ برامج الصيانة الوقائية للمعدات لتقليل الأعطال وتحسين الأداء. الالتزام الصارم بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة والمشاريع. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التمديدات الصحية والتدفئة والغاز. فهم جيد للمبادئ الميكانيكية وأنظمة التمديدات المختلفة. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في المدينة المنورة، ينبع. ستتاح للمرشح الفرصة للعمل ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة دار الحماية لاجهزة السلامة. تقديم الطلبات الرجاء تقديم طلبك إذا كنت تستوفي المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه وتتطلع إلى الانضمام إلى فريق عمل محترف.

6d91f7e9b0c95790.description: About the Role Taj Dhabi is seeking a Technical Engineer – Mechanical to join their team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is responsible for providing technical engineering and coordination support for mechanical works throughout the project lifecycle, with a particular focus on the QRV project and associated large-scale infrastructure and building services works. The position requires 5-10 years of experience and is exclusively open to Saudi nationals. Key Responsibilities Review mechanical design drawings, specifications, BOQs, contract documents, and equipment schedules to ensure compliance with project requirements. Coordinate HVAC, chilled water, ventilation, plumbing, drainage, water supply, firefighting, and other mechanical systems relevant to the QRV project. Prepare, review, coordinate, and follow up on mechanical shop drawings, technical submittals, material submittals, method statements, and calculations. Identify discrepancies, design gaps, missing information, interface issues, and constructability concerns in IFC/design information. Prepare and follow up on RFIs, technical queries, design clarifications, and engineering submissions with consultants and stakeholders. Coordinate mechanical systems with Electrical, Architectural, Structural, Civil, and BIM disciplines for multidisciplinary integration. Provide technical support to construction teams for mechanical installation, coordination, sequencing, and site technical issues. Coordinate with subcontractors, suppliers, and manufacturers regarding technical requirements, equipment selection, and material compliance. Review technical data, catalogues, calculations, and material proposals for compliance with project specifications. Support technical evaluation and comparison of proposed mechanical equipment, materials, and alternative engineering solutions. Assist procurement activities by reviewing technical requirements for mechanical long-lead items and vendor documentation. Participate in value engineering and constructability reviews, proposing solutions to improve system performance and cost efficiency. Coordinate with BIM teams to review mechanical models, resolve clashes, and ensure consistency with site requirements. Ensure mechanical deliverables comply with the Saudi Building Code (SBC), international standards, and project specifications. Maintain and update technical trackers for shop drawings, RFIs, material submittals, and approvals. Participate in technical coordination meetings with consultants, subcontractors, and other project stakeholders. Support QA/QC teams in resolving technical issues related to inspections, NCRs, material approvals, and testing. Provide technical support during testing, commissioning, Testing, Adjusting and Balancing (TAB), and system handover activities. Assist with the preparation and review of as-built drawings, O&M documentation, and final handover requirements. Monitor technical deliverables against the project programme and highlight potential delays. Perform other technical duties as assigned by the Technical Manager / MEP Manager. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of experience in mechanical engineering roles. Strong understanding of mechanical systems, including HVAC, plumbing, drainage, and firefighting. Proficiency in reviewing design information, preparing technical submissions, and coordinating with various disciplines. Familiarity with the Saudi Building Code (SBC) and applicable international standards. Experience with BIM coordination and clash detection. Ability to work collaboratively with multiple teams and stakeholders. This position is exclusively open to Saudi nationals. Work Environment The role will be based at project sites and/or Technical Department offices as required. It involves close collaboration with Technical Management, Engineering, BIM, Construction, Procurement, Planning, QA/QC, HSE, consultants, subcontractors, and suppliers. The environment is dynamic and deadline-driven, supporting large-scale and complex construction projects across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia.

6db1b6ee696e561a.description: Who Are We❓ We Are Foodics! a leading restaurant management ecosystem and payment tech provider. Founded in 2014 with headquarter in Riyadh and offices across 5 countries, including UAE, Egypt, Jordan and Kuwait. We are currently serving customers and partners in over 35 different countries worldwide. Our innovative products have successfully processed over 6 billion (yes, billion with a B) orders so far! making Foodics one of the most rapidly evolving SaaS companies to ever emerge from the MENA region. Also Foodics has achieved three rounds of funding, with the latest raising $170 million in the largest SaaS funding round in MENA, boosting its innovation capabilities to better serve business owners. The Job in a Nutshell💡 We are looking to hire a dynamic and energetic Sales Executive to join our team. This role is crucial in driving Foodics’ growth by sourcing, closing, and actively maximizing revenue from new and existing partners, particularly focusing on selling our SaaS software to restaurants. The Sales Executive will play a pivotal role in expanding our international reach and boosting collaboration with digital third-party integration apps. If you are passionate about sales, technology, and thrive in a fast-paced environment, we want to hear from you! What Will You Do❓ Achieve Targets: Maintain a high closing ratio on qualified leads. Meet and exceed daily, weekly, and monthly KPIs to hit sales targets. Lead Generation and Acquisition: Generate new leads by leveraging digital marketing campaigns and participating in industry networking events. Convert demo sessions into confirmed sales. Relationship Management: Establish relationships with new strategic partners and maintain positive business relationships with existing and potential partners to ensure future sales. CRM Proficiency: Use CRM systems to follow up on projects and cases related to customers, ensuring meticulous tracking and reporting of sales activities. Data-Driven Approach: Leverage data and CRM insights to inform sales strategies and optimize performance. Pipeline Generation: Proven ability to generate a sales pipeline that is four times the monthly quota. Skill Development: Complete all scheduled training sessions on new product features and advanced sales techniques. Achieve high scores on product knowledge assessments. Innovative Mindset: Foster a creative and dynamic startup attitude, contributing innovative ideas to drive business growth. What Are We Looking For❓ Educational Background: BS/BA degree in Business, Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field. Sales Experience: 2-3 years of direct sales experience in Information Technology, FMCG, Software, or SaaS industries is preferred. Talented fresh graduates with a passion for SaaS sales will also be considered. Analytical Skills: Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities. Communication Skills: Excellent communication skills in English and Arabic. Fluency in other languages is a plus. Mobility: Valid driver’s license and access to a personal car, with a willingness to conduct fieldwork. Independence: Self-starter with the ability to work independently across functional groups and manage multiple initiatives simultaneously. Adaptability: Flexibility to thrive in a fast-paced and evolving environment. Passion: Enthusiasm for technology and being part of a fast-growing SaaS company. Who Will Excel❓ Previous experience in the SaaS, technology, or F&B industry. A proactive approach with a track record of exceeding sales targets. A collaborative team player with a passion for driving growth and innovation. What We Offer You❗ We believe you will love working at Foodics! We offer highly competitive compensation packages, including bonuses and the potential for shares. We prioritize personal development and offer regular training and an annual learning stipend to tackle new challenges and grow your career in a hyper-growth environment. Join a talented team of over 30 nationalities working in 14 countries, and gain valuable experience in an exciting industry. We offer autonomy, mentoring, and challenging goals that create incredible opportunities for both you and the company.

6db8ce6b417fc06c.description: Summary We are hiring on behalf of a client for a full-time, fully remote Business Development Officer position. The successful candidate will be responsible for managing the full sales cycle, from lead generation and prospecting to negotiation and deal closure, while building strong client relationships and driving business growth within an assigned market segment or territory. This role is suited to a motivated, target-driven professional with 1–3 years of relevant experience in sales or business development, strong negotiation skills, and the ability to work independently in a remote environment. Own the full sales cycle, from lead generation to closing, for an assigned market segment or territory. Build and qualify a sales pipeline through outbound outreach, referrals, and inbound leads. Conduct discovery calls and online presentations to understand client needs and present relevant solutions. Prepare proposals and quotations within approved pricing guidelines. Negotiate commercial terms, close deals, and hand over clients to operations or account management. Achieve monthly sales targets and maintain an accurate, up-to-date CRM pipeline. Provide weekly reports on pipeline progress, conversion rates, sales performance, and market feedback. Requirements 1–3 years of relevant experience in sales, business development, or a related field. Strong negotiation and deal-closing skills. A target-driven mindset with consistent follow-up and strong organizational skills. Excellent relationship-building and consultative communication skills. Self-management, accountability, and the ability to work independently in a remote setup. Experience with CRM platforms such as Zoho, HubSpot, or Salesforce. Familiarity with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, email outreach, and video conferencing tools. Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets for pipeline tracking and reporting. Arabic: Native proficiency. English: Intermediate proficiency for business communication. A reliable internet connection and the ability to perform effectively in a fully remote work environment.

6dff8bf7e0c7bb9d.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة معين للموارد البشرية عن مدير دعاية وإعلان للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذا الدور الإشراف المباشر على كافة الأنشطة المتعلقة بتنظيم وإدارة أعمال الترويج والدعاية والإعلان، بما يضمن التوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية للشركة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية المشاركة في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية لأنشطة الدعاية والإعلان، وتطوير أدوات وأساليب الدعاية والإعلان والأدلة الإرشادية بناءً على السياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. ضمان التزام الموظفين المرؤوسين بالسياسات والإجراءات، وتوجيههم نحو أفضل الممارسات والأساليب الحديثة في مجال الدعاية والإعلان. بناء وإدارة علاقات عمل فعالة مع محطات التلفزة والإذاعة والصحف والمجلات وشركات الاتصالات وغيرها من القنوات الإعلانية لتنفيذ حملات الدعاية والإعلان. ضمان التنسيق والتواصل الفعال مع الشركاء الداخليين والخارجيين لإدارة أنشطة الدعاية والإعلان والتأكد من فعاليتها، بهدف إيصال الرسائل والمعلومات لأكبر شريحة ممكنة من الفئة المستهدفة. متابعة وتوجيه عمليات إعداد التقارير الفنية حول خطط وحملات الترويج والدعاية والإعلان، وتقييم نتائجها وأثرها، ورفع التقارير والتوصيات للإدارة العليا. متابعة آخر المستجدات والتطورات في أساليب وطرق تنفيذ الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية، والتوجيه بتبني المناسب منها. تحديد وضمان توافر جميع الموارد والمواد والتقنيات اللازمة لتنفيذ أعمال وأنشطة الدعاية والإعلان بأفضل صورة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال الدعاية والإعلان أو ما يعادله. القدرة على المشاركة في إعداد الخطط التشغيلية والبرامج التنفيذية. فهم جيد لأساليب وأدوات الدعاية والإعلان الحديثة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة لبناء وإدارة العلاقات مع الشركاء. القدرة على متابعة تنفيذ الحملات الدعائية والإعلانية في مختلف وسائل الإعلام. مهارات تحليلية لتقييم نتائج الحملات وتقديم التوصيات. القدرة على التوجيه والإشراف على فريق العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. يتطلب العمل التنسيق المستمر مع الوحدات التنظيمية الداخلية والشركاء الخارجيين لضمان تحقيق أهداف الدعاية والإعلان. التقديم لمزيد من المعلومات حول هذا الدور أو للتقديم، يرجى التواصل مع شركة معين للموارد البشرية.

6d3daf0339e36120.description: About the Role Virtucruit is collaborating with a prominent mining company in Saudi Arabia to recruit a Drilling Supervisor for their Drilling Operations Department. This full-time position is based in Najran. The successful candidate will be responsible for the effective and safe supervision of drilling operations, ensuring all activities comply with operational requirements, safety standards, and established procedures. Role Overview The Drilling Supervisor will oversee drilling crews, coordinate daily drilling activities, and monitor equipment performance. A primary focus of this role is to ensure that production targets are met efficiently while maintaining high standards of safety, productivity, and operational performance. This position requires strong leadership and hands-on drilling experience. Key Responsibilities Ensure the highest level of safety, health, and environmental work standards are maintained across all drilling sites. Enforce strict adherence to company HSE policies, procedures, and safe work practices. Supervise daily drilling operations, including rig performance, crew activities, and site workflows. Plan, organize, and coordinate drilling activities in line with approved drilling programs. Oversee site preparation, drill pad construction, and access road readiness. Ensure drilling rigs are properly mobilized, positioned, and commissioned. Monitor drilling progress, penetration rates, and core recovery to meet operational targets. Coordinate with geologists regarding drill collar locations, orientations, and target depths. Ensure all drilling equipment is maintained, inspected, and serviced regularly. Conduct daily site inspections to identify hazards and enforce corrective actions. Lead daily toolbox meetings, shift briefings, and safety discussions. Review and approve daily drilling reports, logs, and production data. Manage workforce allocation, shift schedules, and contractor performance. Investigate incidents, near misses, and operational issues. Ensure compliance with environmental and regulatory requirements on site. Monitor drilling consumables usage and control operational costs. Provide technical guidance and troubleshooting support to crews. Maintain communication with management regarding site performance and issues. Support continuous improvement initiatives and operational efficiencies. Develop, mentor, and train local workforce and junior staff. Qualifications and Experience 5-10 years of experience in drilling operations. Sound knowledge of drilling operations and equipment. Proven ability to manage drilling teams effectively. Strong leadership capabilities. Application Process Salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process.

6d418011cf8c712b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهى الفندقية عن أخصائي صحة وسلامة مهنية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى ضمان تطبيق أعلى معايير الأمن والسلامة داخل مرافق الفندق، والمساهمة في توفير بيئة آمنة للموظفين والزوار. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تطبيق أنظمة وتعليمات الأمن والسلامة المعتمدة داخل الفندق. إجراء جولات تفقدية دورية على جميع مرافق الفندق للتأكد من سلامتها. مراقبة مخارج الطوارئ ومسارات الإخلاء والتأكد من خلوها من أي عوائق. التأكد من جاهزية طفايات الحريق وأنظمة ومعدات السلامة الأخرى. متابعة التزام الموظفين والزوار بإجراءات السلامة المحددة. التعامل مع حالات الطوارئ والحوادث وفقاً للإجراءات المعتمدة. إعداد تقارير مفصلة عن الحوادث والملاحظات المتعلقة بالسلامة. تنفيذ وتنسيق تدريبات الإخلاء والطوارئ بشكل دوري. التنسيق مع الجهات المختصة عند الضرورة لضمان الامتثال لمعايير السلامة. رفع تقارير دورية للإدارة حول مستوى السلامة والمخاطر المحتملة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال السلامة، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع الفنادق أو الضيافة. معرفة جيدة بإجراءات السلامة والطوارئ ومكافحة الحريق. القدرة على التعامل الفعال مع الحالات الطارئة. مهارات جيدة في التواصل والمتابعة. يفضل وجود شهادات أو دورات معتمدة في مجال السلامة. بيئة العمل يقع مقر العمل في مدينة الرياض، وهو دور بدوام كامل ضمن بيئة فندقية ديناميكية تتطلب اليقظة والالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

6d5975a56bc90099.description: About Baker Hughes Baker Hughes is a global energy technology company operating in over 120 countries. The Operations (ARMO) team focuses on equipment maintenance, repair, and operational excellence to ensure reliable performance and customer support. This role is based in Al-Ahsa, Al-Ahsa Governorate, Saudi Arabia. Role Overview As an Assembly Repair Maintenance & Overhaul (ARMO) Mechanic, you will be responsible for troubleshooting, testing, assembling, disassembling, and visually inspecting mechanical assemblies. This full-time position involves assisting with the repair and modification of non-conforming equipment, performing complex tests with minimal supervision, and providing technical support across the business while adhering to HS&E policies. The role requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Perform routine preventative and corrective maintenance on coiled tubing units, injectors, reels, trailers, power packs, and fluid pumps. Diagnose and repair mechanical, hydraulic, pneumatic, and diesel engine issues to ensure maximum reliability during well operations. Maintain, test, and assemble products, tools, and sub-assemblies for operations. Work according to pre-defined procedures and established work practices. Assist in reworking, repairing, and modifying non-conforming equipment. Provide coaching to other technicians in areas of proven competence. Handle special projects as assigned. Comply with HS&E policies and procedures. Qualifications and Requirements A Diploma or equivalent qualification. A minimum of 5 years of experience in coiled tubing equipment maintenance. Ability to work efficiently in a team environment and communicate effectively. A dedicated focus on safety and quality. Ability to perform basic mathematical calculations, good mechanical aptitude, and basic computer skills. Knowledge of workshop equipment and their uses, including shop tooling, measurement tools, and material handling equipment. Work Conditions and Benefits This position operates on a shift-based working pattern with opportunities for overtime. Candidates may be required to be on call after hours and weekends on a rotating schedule. Baker Hughes offers contemporary work-life balance policies, wellbeing activities, comprehensive private medical care options, life insurance, disability programs, tailored financial programs, and additional elected or voluntary benefits.

6d637ec76537ce38.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة عمر عبدالله الحربي التجارية عن أمين صندوق للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على الإدارة المالية والتخطيط، بما في ذلك إدارة التدفقات النقدية والسيولة والتمويل. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة، ويهدف إلى ضمان الكفاءة المالية وتحليل المخاطر. المسؤوليات الرئيسية سيتولى أمين الصندوق مسؤولية إدارة الجوانب المالية الحيوية للمؤسسة، مع التركيز على تحليل السيولة والمخاطر المرتبطة بها. تشمل المهام اليومية إدارة الأرصدة النقدية وتوقع التدفقات النقدية لضمان الاستقرار المالي. إدارة الأرصدة النقدية اليومية وتحليل التدفق النقدي من العمليات والاستثمار والتمويل. ضمان كفاية التدفقات النقدية وتوقع المدفوعات النقدية والتنبؤ بالمشكلات الناشئة عن محدودية التدفق النقدي. تحليل متطلبات رأس المال في العمليات التجارية والمعاملات والالتزامات الأخرى. تقديم الدعم في وضع سياسات وإجراءات الرقابة الداخلية المتعلقة بإدارة الموازنة والنقد والائتمان والمحاسبة. تحليل المخاطر المرتبطة بالتدفقات النقدية وإدارتها، وإجراء تحليل الحساسية لتقييم تقلبات التدفقات النقدية فيما يتعلق بالمخاطر التشغيلية والتمويلية. تحليل خيارات وشروط التمويل وتحديدها لتتناسب مع الاحتياجات التشغيلية والاستثمارية، والسعي للحصول على مصادر التمويل والتفاوض حول شروط التمويل. المؤهلات والخبرة يتطلب هذا الدور مرشحاً يمتلك أساساً قوياً في الإدارة المالية والقدرة على تحليل البيانات المالية المعقدة. الخبرة العملية في مجال مماثل ستكون ذات قيمة. خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد لمبادئ التخطيط المالي وإدارة التدفقات النقدية. القدرة على إجراء تحليل السيولة وسعر الفائدة والعملة والمخاطر المرتبطة بذلك. المهارات المطلوبة يجب أن يمتلك المرشح مهارات تحليلية قوية وقدرة على التعامل مع البيانات المالية بدقة، بالإضافة إلى مهارات التواصل الفعال لدعم وضع السياسات والإجراءات. مهارات تحليلية قوية في تقييم المخاطر المالية. القدرة على التنبؤ بالمشكلات المالية المحتملة وتقديم الحلول. مهارات التفاوض في الحصول على مصادر التمويل. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق وتقديم الدعم في تطوير السياسات. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويقع في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة. سيعمل أمين الصندوق ضمن فريق مالي لدعم الأهداف الاستراتيجية لمؤسسة عمر عبدالله الحربي التجارية. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على المؤهلات والخبرة. نحن نشجع المرشحين المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه على تقديم طلباتهم.

6d749c46cb8d7dcc.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة التداوي والحياه الطبي عن مدير إداري للانضمام إلى فريقها في المنطقة الشرقية، بمدينة الدمام. يهدف هذا الدور إلى الإشراف العام على الأنشطة الإدارية وضمان سير العمليات بكفاءة عالية، مع التركيز على تطوير الأهداف الإدارية وتوفير الموارد اللازمة. الهدف الرئيسي للدور يشارك المدير الإداري في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، ويشرف على تخطيط وتنظيم الأعمال الإدارية ضمن نطاق إشرافه. يضمن الدور توافر الموارد التقنية والبشرية اللازمة لسير العمليات اليومية بأقصى قدر من الكفاءة والفعالية، بما يتوافق مع الخطط التشغيلية المعتمدة. المهام والمسؤوليات المشاركة في تطوير الأهداف الرئيسية للشؤون الإدارية، وتطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج والمشروعات التي تساهم في تحقيق هذه الأهداف. التأكد من وجود الأطر والمقاييس الدقيقة لمعرفة مستوى تحقيق الخطط والأهداف الإدارية. الإشراف على عمليات تطوير جداول الصلاحيات الإدارية والإجراءات المتبعة ومراجعتها باستمرار لتحسينها وضمان تقديم الخدمات الإدارية بالجودة والسرعة المطلوبة. متابعة وتوجيه أنشطة تلبية احتياجات الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين من الخدمات الإدارية المختلفة، مثل النقل والضيافة والنظافة وتنظيم المراسلات والأرشفة والتشغيل الإداري للمباني والمرافق. الإشراف على تطبيق الأنظمة والتعليمات والقرارات الإدارية المتبعة، وضمان إبلاغ الوحدات التنظيمية والموظفين بكافة القرارات والتعليمات الإدارية الصادرة عن الإدارة العليا ومتابعة تنفيذها. الإشراف على عمليات إعداد وتحضير الملخصات والتقارير التي توضح نسب الإنجاز العامة فيما يتعلق بالشؤون الإدارية وعرضها على الإدارة العليا. إحاطة الإدارة العليا بمختلف التحديات والمستجدات، واستشارتهم في القضايا والمبادرات المستقبلية المهمة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين إلى 5 سنوات في مجال إداري ذي صلة. القدرة على تطوير وتنفيذ الخطط والبرامج الإدارية. مهارات إشرافية ممتازة لضمان سير العمليات الإدارية بكفاءة. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل المنطقة الشرقية، الدمام.

6db289429d97b690.description: About the Role GE Vernova is seeking a Manufacturing Engineer to lead manufacturing engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary skids and modular systems. This full-time position is based in Dammam, Eastern Province, and focuses on ensuring safe, efficient, and high-quality production operations. The role involves driving manufacturing processes from engineering release through shop-floor execution, with a strong emphasis on technical leadership and cross-functional coordination. Key Responsibilities Lead manufacturing engineering activities for gas turbine auxiliary systems, including piping, mechanical assembly, electrical, and instrumentation. Review engineering packages to ensure manufacturing readiness before execution. Develop and maintain Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), routing, work instructions (WI), and other manufacturing documentation. Define make-versus-buy strategies and coordinate with sourcing and planning teams. Ensure alignment between engineering drawings, material requirements, and manufacturing processes. Support shop-floor execution by resolving technical issues and driving timely problem resolution. Coordinate with Operations, Quality, Planning, and Materials teams to ensure smooth production flow and eliminate bottlenecks. Lead root cause analysis (RCA, 8D, 4D) for manufacturing and quality issues. Support the implementation and sustainment of Build-in-Quality (BIQ) practices and Lean manufacturing initiatives. Drive continuous improvement activities focused on Safety, Quality, Delivery, and Cost (SQDC). Support functional testing and inspection readiness activities. Ensure compliance with project specifications, customer requirements, and applicable international standards (*, ASME, API, ISO, ATEX, IECEX, UL). Support manpower planning, capacity reviews, and manufacturing readiness assessments for new projects. Make decisions on training needs for the production team. Mentor and support junior engineers, Engineering Change Technicians (ECTs), and shop-floor teams on manufacturing processes and technical requirements. Participate in LEAN initiatives and engage Six Sigma tools for process improvements. Develop and implement process improvements to reduce costs and cycle times. Implement productivity actions and participate in EHS-related actions to improve safety in the assigned area. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should possess 2-5 years of experience in a manufacturing engineering role, preferably within a related industry. The role requires a strong technical background and proven ability to lead manufacturing processes from design to execution. Required Skills Proficiency in manufacturing readiness and process development. Experience with Manufacturing BOM (MBOM), routing, and work instruction development. Strong technical problem-solving skills, including root cause analysis (RCA, 8D, 4D). Familiarity with Build-in-Quality (BIQ) practices and Lean manufacturing principles. Knowledge of applicable international standards (ASME, API, ISO, ATEX, IECEX, UL). Ability to coordinate effectively with cross-functional teams. Leadership skills to mentor junior engineers and shop-floor teams. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Dammam, Eastern Province. The role involves working closely with operations, quality, planning, and materials teams in a production environment. Application Process Interested candidates are encouraged to apply. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6db4eacdb30e287c.description: About Abdul Latif Jameel Abdul Latif Jameel is a diversified business with a strong presence across the Middle East, North Africa, and Turkey (MENAT region). With over 75 years of experience, the company has evolved from a trading business and Toyota distributorship in Jeddah, Saudi Arabia, into a significant regional player. Abdul Latif Jameel has built an extensive operational infrastructure and the largest vehicle distribution network in Saudi Arabia, leveraging its automotive expertise to diversify into new sectors that support the 'infrastructure of life' in the MENAT region. The Role of Stockyard Coordinator Abdul Latif Jameel is seeking a Stockyard Coordinator to join its team in Makkah, with operations spanning Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time position involves handling daily arrival and dispatch operations, managing data entry, and responding to center queries. The role operates under high supervision for daily operational activities and has low authority over daily functional operations, with a direct impact on locating parked vehicles and updating the system. Key Responsibilities Manage all emails and key tasks for the regional stockyard, ensuring the achievement of set KPIs through cross-functional support. Align all work with arrival and dispatch supervisors to meet objectives and center expectations (retail, Lexus). Maintain close communication with the Regional Sales Team to provide complete logistical support from regional stockyards to frontline sales. Monitor Accessory Installation Center (AIC) operations to ensure timely vehicle dispatch. Oversee frozen and damaged vehicles, controlling stock and dispatching in accordance with company policy. Ensure compliance with IMTITHAL standards related to the workplace and implement corrective measures for outstanding audit points. Performance Indicators and Impact The Stockyard Coordinator's performance is measured by overall productivity, including all arrival, dispatch, Pre-Delivery Inspection (PDI), and Stock Transfer Movement (STM) activities. Key indicators also include damage ratio during operation, accuracy of the location system for all vehicles, and the NPS score from the GDI Survey for the ALJR Channel. The role is crucial for ensuring overall RDC on-time dispatch within specified lead times, with a target volume of 600 per head as per KPI book. The job holder has an indirect impact on managing the damage ratio. Qualifications and Requirements 5-10 years of relevant experience. Basic knowledge of supply chain and sales channels. Ability to ensure compliance with IMTITHAL standards across the workplace. Responsibility for controlling and dispatching damaged vehicle stock. Compensation This full-time position offers a monthly float of 20,000 SR. The role includes standard CAPEX for a desk and PC.

6de602e0d3f8e839.description: About Zuma Restaurants Zuma is a collection of contemporary Japanese restaurants, drawing inspiration from the Izakaya dining style. As part of the Azumi collection, Zuma operates globally with four locations across the Middle East, including Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Doha, and Riyadh. These venues are recognized for their commitment to high standards and elevating guest experiences within the hospitality sector. The Role of Sushi Head Chef Zuma Restaurants is seeking a Sushi Head Chef to lead the sushi operation in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to the guest experience, focusing on creating memorable moments and maintaining the high standards that define the Zuma dining experience. The Sushi Head Chef embodies the restaurant's vibrant energy and contributes to its core values of honoring mastery, supporting team members, and embracing positivity. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee the sushi operation, ensuring consistent high standards of food quality, presentation, and taste during all services. Maintain sufficient levels of sushi mise en place, fish preparation, and kitchen preparation to ensure smooth service flow. Lead, mentor, and develop the sushi team through training, guidance, and support to meet and exceed Zuma standards. Take overall responsibility for the performance of the sushi section, ensuring consistent dish preparation and delivery to required standards. Ensure correct handling, preparation, and storage of fish and all sushi ingredients, maintaining freshness, quality, and food safety. Collaborate with senior management to evaluate guest feedback and identify opportunities for continuous improvement of the sushi offering and dining experience. Manage and monitor sushi section costs, stock levels, product quality, and waste to ensure commercial effectiveness. Ensure consistent adherence to all health, safety, hygiene, and food safety standards within the sushi operation. Work with the senior culinary team to develop and refine the sushi offering, incorporating seasonal ingredients, traditional Japanese techniques, and innovative Japanese-inspired concepts. Candidate Requirements A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant culinary role. Demonstrated ability to lead and manage a sushi operation in a high-standard environment. Strong understanding of Japanese culinary techniques and traditions. Commitment to maintaining exceptional food quality, consistency, and presentation. Proficiency in managing kitchen costs, stock, and waste. Thorough knowledge of health, safety, hygiene, and food safety standards. Work Environment and Culture At Zuma, the work environment is described as a vibrant community. The company values mastery, mutual support, and a positive approach to work. Zuma is an equal opportunities employer and welcomes all applicants. Assistance for accessibility during the recruitment process can be provided by the Talent Acquisition team. Application Process Candidates interested in contributing to contemporary dining on a global stage are encouraged to apply.

6dfd96628e94a3a4.description: About the Role BD is seeking a Clinical Sales Specialist for Specimen Management (SM) in Jeddah. This full-time role focuses on driving sales growth and providing clinical support for BD’s Specimen Management portfolio. The specialist will work to build customer relationships, ensure product adoption, and contribute to patient outcomes across the Western and Southern regions. BD's Vision for Specimen Management Diagnostic test results influence over 70% of clinical decisions, making accurate specimen collection and transport critical. BD’s Specimen Management business is a global leader in preanalytics, providing high-quality devices annually to support reliable diagnostic outcomes. These technologies enhance the safe and efficient handling of diagnostic specimens, enabling informed clinical decisions across various healthcare scenarios, from routine checkups to disease diagnosis and treatment. Key offerings include BD Vacutainer® products for blood and urine collection, designed to ensure accurate results throughout the testing process. Responsibilities Achieve sales targets and drive growth within the assigned territory. Develop and execute strategic plans to expand market share and identify new opportunities. Deliver product demonstrations, presentations, and clinical training to healthcare professionals. Provide ongoing clinical support, including troubleshooting and technical guidance. Build and maintain relationships with key stakeholders, including Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs), procurement, and clinicians. Monitor market trends and customer needs, sharing insights with internal teams. Collaborate cross-functionally with marketing, technical support, and customer service to enhance customer experience. Represent BD at conferences, workshops, and industry events. Maintain accurate sales forecasts, reports, and administrative documentation. Ensure full compliance with company policies, industry regulations, and ethical standards. Qualifications and Experience Candidates should have 2-5 years of relevant experience for this role. Work Environment and Culture BD values individuals who can understand the broader context and human impact of their work. The company fosters a culture of learning, growth, and collaboration, emphasizing face-to-face interaction to support professional development and success.

6d247fa4ee0fd1bb.job_title: Architecture and Urban Planning Engineer - Fresh Graduate
6d247fa4ee0fd1bb.description: We are looking for a motivated fresh graduate in Architecture and Urban Planning to join our client's team. The ideal candidate should have a relevant bachelor's degree and basic knowledge of architectural design and urban planning. Key Responsibilities Assist in preparing architectural drawings, layouts, and design plans. Support urban planning and development projects. Prepare technical reports and project documentation. Assist in reviewing drawings and design specifications. Coordinate with engineering and project teams. Bachelor's degree in Architecture, Urban Planning, or a related field. Fresh graduates only; no prior work experience required. Basic knowledge of AutoCAD and relevant design software. Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications. Good communication and teamwork skills. Willingness to learn and develop professional skills.

6dc003dd392c6440.description: We are seeking an experienced Project Manager to lead and oversee multiple projects from initiation to completion, ensuring they are delivered on time, within budget, securing required resources and meet quality standards. The ideal candidate will be responsible for developing project plans, managing cross-functional teams, identifying and mitigating risks, and maintaining clear communication with stakeholders throughout the project lifecycle. Key responsibilities include coordinating resources, monitoring project progress, implementing best practices in project management methodologies, and driving continuous improvement initiatives to enhance operational efficiency. In addition to the project management dole, the ideal candidate should actively participate in business development, technical and commercial proposal development (using Microsoft PowerPoint) and have the ability to identify and bid in Etimad Platform.

6d91ae64ab317fbc.description: About the Role Larsen & Toubro is seeking an Electrical Execution Engineer TL to join their team in Makkah, with work also extending to Jeddah. This full-time position is ideal for professionals with 0-1 years of experience, focusing on the administration and supervision of electrical construction activities within projects. Key Responsibilities Report to the construction/project manager and administer construction activities. Liaise with the construction/project manager, client, and subcontractors, supervising allocated construction activities. Ensure compliance with specifications to meet client satisfaction. Develop detailed weekly programs for construction activities and prepare manpower/resource requirements for timely project completion. Prepare and submit daily reports. Coordinate construction activities for various electrical services to ensure and enforce correct sequencing. Conduct regular construction meetings with site staff and subcontractors to review, control, communicate, and assess progress. Ensure steady and timely progress against monthly schedules and manage measurement & certification of subcontractor invoices. Ensure all information related to technical drawings, electrical equipment lists, construction equipment lists, and technical specifications are updated and readily available. Ensure submission of marked-up drawings and test reports. Implement the established Quality Assurance & EHS Plan across the site. Check the relevance and accuracy of documentation during inter-disciplinary coordination and resolve construction-related problems swiftly. Promote a favorable work culture that encourages ethical and professional practice by all employees at the project site. Address significant issues before they adversely impact the company and client. Perform any other tasks or duties as designated by the Project/Construction Manager. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 0-1 years of relevant experience in electrical execution engineering. A strong understanding of construction activities and project management principles is essential for this role. Work Environment This is a full-time position based in Makkah, with responsibilities extending to projects in Jeddah. The role involves working closely with project management, clients, and subcontractors on construction sites. Application Process Larsen & Toubro invites qualified candidates to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

6da8918688341ccd.description: About the Role PROVEN is seeking a PMO Manager Live Events & Festivals to join our client's operations in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. This contract position involves overseeing programme controls and governance for large-scale live events and festivals within Saudi Arabia's esports and live entertainment industry. The role focuses on ensuring effective coordination, transparency, and successful delivery of complex event programmes. Role Context The client operates within the dynamic esports and live entertainment sector in Saudi Arabia, contributing to the delivery of major events and festivals. This organization is committed to creating engaging visitor experiences through innovative event planning and operational excellence. The PMO Manager will be central to maintaining programme integrity and successful execution. Key Responsibilities Lead and oversee programme controls and functions for large-scale live events and festivals. Develop, maintain, and monitor integrated master schedules to ensure alignment across project workstreams and delivery milestones. Establish and manage programme registers, including risks, issues, actions, decisions, and dependencies. Implement and maintain structured change control processes to assess, track, and communicate programme changes. Oversee document control systems, ensuring accurate version management, approvals, and accessibility of project documentation. Monitor programme progress, identify schedule deviations, and coordinate corrective actions with relevant stakeholders. Prepare consolidated programme dashboards, progress reports, and performance updates for senior management. Coordinate with cross-functional teams and key stakeholders to ensure effective programme integration. Support programme governance, reporting standards, and continuous improvement of PMO processes. Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience in programme management, master scheduling, project registers, change management, and document control. Experience range of 5-10 years in a relevant field. Proven ability to manage complex event programmes effectively. Work Type and Location This is a contract position based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role requires working within a dynamic environment focused on large-scale live events and festivals.

6dbec3a595e463b5.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة فيا فلاي عن كاتب تذاكر سفر للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى تقديم خدمات السفر المتكاملة للعملاء، بما في ذلك حجز تذاكر الطيران والفنادق وتنظيم الرحلات، مع التركيز على تقديم خدمة عالية الجودة. المسؤوليات الرئيسية تسويق وبيع وتنظيم عروض تذاكر السفر والرحلات لمختلف وسائل النقل. ترتيب حجوزات السفر والرحلات البرية أو الجوية أو البحرية نيابة عن العملاء، بالتنسيق مع وكالات السفر ومنظمي الرحلات. الرد على استفسارات العملاء المتعلقة بحجوزات التذاكر والجولات السياحية ووسائل النقل والوجهات المطلوبة. إدارة العلاقات مع الموردين والعملاء الرئيسيين والحفاظ عليها، وتنفيذ حلول فعالة لضمان خدمة بمعايير عالية. اتباع السياسات والإجراءات الداخلية لضمان الالتزام بالأنظمة واللوائح ذات الصلة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. يفضل من لديه خبرة سابقة في العمل على نظام أماديوس وحاصل على شهادة معتمدة في هذا المجال. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق شركة فيا فلاي في مدينة جدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب التفاعل المباشر مع العملاء والموردين. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة. التقديم ندعو المهتمين الذين يستوفون المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه للتقديم على هذا الدور.

6d920437baa7cdd6.description: About the Role Mövenpick Hotel & Residences Riyadh is seeking a Chef de Cuisine specializing in Moroccan Cuisine. This full-time role involves leading the authentic North African culinary offerings and overseeing daily kitchen operations for Moroccan culinary concepts. The position is based in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, and requires a professional with 5-10 years of experience in a similar capacity within a 5-star Accor property environment. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and execute authentic Moroccan menus, including traditional Tagines, Couscous, Pastilla, Mezza, pastries, and banquet offerings. Preserve authentic Maghrebi flavor profiles while applying modern 5-star plating techniques and high culinary presentation standards. Conduct regular menu engineering and seasonal refreshes in line with guest preferences, market trends, and Accor brand guidelines. Lead live-cooking stations, private dining experiences, and special Moroccan cultural culinary promotions. Direct daily kitchen operations, prep work, and service execution to ensure seamless timing and consistent dish quality. Establish standardized recipe sheets, yield charts, and picture specifications for all dishes to ensure consistency. Manage kitchen staffing schedules, station assignments, and operational workflows to optimize labor efficiency. Oversee raw ingredient receiving, storage, and inventory levels, ensuring authentic Moroccan spices and specialist ingredients are sourced to standard. Quality Control and Hygiene Enforce strict compliance with Saudi Food and Drug Authority (SFDA) regulations, HACCP protocols, and Accor Food Safety standards. Conduct daily hygiene inspections of workstations, cold storage, equipment, and personal grooming across the culinary team. Supervise temperature controls, food labeling, rotation (FIFO), and allergen management protocols. Financial Management Manage kitchen food costs to meet targeted budgets without compromising culinary quality or portions. Monitor daily food waste, portion controls, and yield management to minimize operational loss. Assist the Executive Chef in annual operating budgets, menu pricing strategies, and equipment capital expenditure planning. Team Leadership and Development Recruit, train, mentor, and evaluate kitchen staff, fostering a collaborative and high-performance environment. Conduct regular culinary workshops on traditional Moroccan cooking techniques, spice blending, and slow-cooking methods for junior chefs. Support national talent development and Saudization initiatives through targeted operational mentoring and career planning. Qualifications and Experience Demonstrated experience as a Chef de Cuisine, specifically with Moroccan cuisine. A minimum of 5-10 years of culinary experience, preferably within a 5-star hotel or luxury dining setting. Mastery of authentic Moroccan techniques, flavors, and spice profiles. Strong leadership, financial acumen, and operational discipline. Ability to ensure high standards of food quality, authenticity, presentation, and hygiene.

6dbc490ff042cfc9.description: نبذة عن الدور تعلن مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس عن حاجتها لأخصائي خدمة عملاء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على تطوير وتحسين جودة خدمة العملاء، وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء، والمشاركة في وضع الإجراءات والأدلة لضمان رضا العملاء. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء الدراسات والتحاليل المتخصصة لوضع وتحديد مؤشرات الأداء الرئيسية ومعايير الجودة لخدمة العملاء، بالتنسيق مع إدارة الجودة، ومتابعتها لضمان سير العمل بكفاءة. المشاركة في وضع وتحديث إجراءات وأدلة خدمة العملاء، بما في ذلك تفاصيل الاتصال بهم واستلام طلباتهم واستفساراتهم والرد عليها بفعالية ومهنية، والتنسيق مع الإدارات المعنية. تطوير برامج ومبادرات لتعزيز جودة ومهنية أنظمة خدمة العملاء، بهدف تجاوز توقعات واحتياجات المتعاملين وبناء نموذج متكامل لخدمة العملاء. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء، وتقييم رضا العملاء، وتحديد الأنماط المتكررة للشكاوى والثغرات، ووضع خطط لمعالجتها. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بخدمة العملاء، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح بين 0-1 سنة في مجال خدمة العملاء أو مجال ذي صلة. القدرة على وضع وتحديد مؤشرات ومعايير الأداء والجودة. مهارات تحليلية قوية لتحديد نقاط القوة والضعف في أنظمة خدمة العملاء. القدرة على إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة، شفهية وكتابية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتنسيق مع الإدارات المختلفة. مهارات حل المشكلات واتخاذ القرار. الاهتمام بالتفاصيل والدقة في العمل. بيئة العمل هذا الدور بدوام كامل في مستشفى الدكتور سمير محمد علي عباس بجدة، مكة المكرمة، ويتطلب الالتزام بتقديم خدمة عملاء عالية الجودة ضمن بيئة عمل داعمة ومتطورة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات.

6dc01fd88b38a24e.description: About the Role Red Sea Global is seeking an Openwater Instructor to deliver high-quality scuba diving training and experiences. This full-time, site-based role involves ensuring the safe and professional delivery of diving programs within a luxury marine tourism environment. The instructor will be responsible for student safety, course delivery, and adherence to training agency standards, while also supporting daily dive center operations. Company Overview Red Sea Sports & Entertainment (RSSE), a subsidiary of Red Sea Global (RSG), is responsible for designing and delivering land and marine experiences at The Red Sea destination. RSSE manages and operates a portfolio of sports, adventure, and leisure offerings, including water sports through Galaxea, adventure activities via Akun, and leisure experiences delivered by WAMA. RSSE also supports the partnership between Red Sea Global and the Saudi Olympic & Paralympic Committee to promote sports and recreational experiences. Key Responsibilities Deliver scuba diving courses and programs in accordance with recognized training agency standards (*, PADI, SSI, or equivalent). Ensure all training sessions are conducted safely and professionally, adhering to company policies. Provide guest service that ensures a memorable learning experience. Support the Dive Center Manager in the day-to-day operations of the dive center. Maintain a professional appearance and uphold luxury hospitality standards. Assist in the setup and operational readiness of training facilities, classrooms, and confined/open water sites during pre-opening. Conduct academic, confined water, and open water training sessions for entry-level and advanced courses. Deliver thorough pre-dive and post-dive briefings. Supervise and guide students during all in-water activities, ensuring adherence to safety standards. Assess student performance and certify participants according to training agency requirements. Support dive excursions and guide certified divers as needed. Assist with equipment preparation, fitting, and post-dive care. Maintain accurate student records, certifications, and training documentation. Promote responsible diving practices and environmental conservation awareness. Health, Safety, and Quality Prioritize safety in all training and diving activities. Ensure compliance with all diving standards, emergency procedures, and risk management protocols. Maintain current first aid, CPR, and emergency oxygen provider certifications. Promote environmental stewardship, including reef protection and marine conservation awareness. Adhere to all company policies, SOPs, and training agency standards. Maintain accurate documentation, including training records, incident reports, and certification paperwork. Report any incidents, risks, or operational concerns promptly to management. Qualifications and Experience 2-5 years of experience in a relevant field. Certification as an Open Water Scuba Instructor from a recognized training agency (*, PADI, SSI, or equivalent). Current first aid, CPR, and emergency oxygen provider certifications. Ability to stay updated with the latest diving standards, teaching methodologies, and industry best practices. Work Environment This role operates within a luxury dive center and marine tourism environment. It requires flexibility to work weekends, holidays, and during peak seasons. The position involves regular in-water activities and exposure to varying environmental conditions, playing a key role in delivering safe, high-quality training and guest experiences.

6d2e15b83930131f.description: About the Role Ninja (quick-commerce) is seeking an experienced Stock Control Supervisor to lead inventory control activities within its Central Warehouse in Abha, Aseer Province. Key Responsibilities Supervise daily stock control activities and ensure inventory accuracy. Plan and oversee cycle counts, targeted counts, and inventory audits. Investigate inventory discrepancies and identify root causes. Review and validate inventory adjustments according to approved procedures. Lead the stock control team and allocate daily workloads. Monitor inventory accuracy KPIs and prepare performance reports. Coordinate with Warehouse Operations, Finance, IT/WMS, Quality & Safety, and other relevant teams. Ensure compliance with inventory control procedures and audit requirements. Drive corrective actions and continuous improvement initiatives. Qualifications and Experience 5–7 years of relevant experience in Stock Control, Inventory Control, Warehouse Operations, or Logistics, including supervisory experience. Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations Management, Business Administration, or a related field. Strong knowledge of inventory control processes, procedures, and KPIs. Experience with WMS/ERP systems and good knowledge of Microsoft Excel. Experience in inventory counting, discrepancy investigation, reconciliation, and root-cause analysis. Work Environment This role is based in Abha, Aseer Province, and involves working in a dynamic central warehouse setting. 6d78d0f78fcc8a83.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة قطعة قماش للتجارة عن بائع ملابس جاهزة للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. يهدف هذا الدور إلى تلبية احتياجات العملاء وتقديم تجربة تسوق مميزة، مع التركيز على بيع المنتجات وتقديم معلومات دقيقة عنها. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية بيع مجموعة متنوعة من الملابس الجاهزة للزبائن. توفير معلومات شاملة للزبائن حول المنتجات، بما في ذلك الاستخدامات والأسعار. مراقبة مستويات المخزون بانتظام وضمان ترتيب المتجر بشكل مستمر. إصدار طلبات شراء المنتجات الجديدة والتعامل مع المنتجات الواردة. إدارة عمليات الدفع وتلقي المدفوعات من الزبائن بكفاءة. معالجة طلبات استبدال المنتجات والمرتجعات وفقًا لسياسات الشركة المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى سنة واحدة في مجال المبيعات، ويفضل أن تكون في قطاع الملابس الجاهزة. القدرة على التواصل بفعالية مع الزبائن وتقديم خدمة عملاء ممتازة. الالتزام بترتيب وتنظيم بيئة العمل. نوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل. موقع العمل جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

6dbe73b0efdff974.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة الحمزي للمقاولات عن مراقب جودة للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور إلى ضمان تنفيذ جميع أعمال البناء والتشييد والمواد المستخدمة في الموقع وفقاً للمخططات الهندسية المعتمدة ومواصفات العقد ومعايير الجودة والسلامة القياسية. يتولى مراقب الجودة مسؤولية رصد أي انحرافات والعمل على تصحيحها لضمان تسليم المشاريع دون عيوب. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إجراء جولات تفتيشية يومية ومستمرة في موقع العمل لمراقبة جودة التنفيذ في مختلف المراحل، بما في ذلك أعمال الحفر، الحدادة، النجارة، صب الخرسانة، التشطيبات، والأنظمة الميكانيكية والكهربائية. فحص واختبار المواد والمعدات الموردة إلى الموقع للتأكد من مطابقتها للمواصفات الفنية المعتمدة، ومراجعة شهادات المنشأ والاختبار الخاصة بها. استلام طلبات الفحص المقدمة من القسم التنفيذي، وإجراء المعاينات المشتركة مع الاستشاري لضمان اعتماد الأعمال. إصدار تقارير حالات عدم المطابقة (NCR) عند رصد أي أعمال أو مواد مخالفة للمواصفات، ومتابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية اللازمة. رفع تقارير دورية (يومية/أسبوعية) لمهندس الجودة أو مدير المشروع توضح حالة جودة الأعمال ونسب الإنجاز وأي تحديات تواجه الموقع. التنسيق المستمر مع مهندسي الموقع، المشرفين، وممثلي المالك أو الاستشاري لضمان سلاسة سير العمل وحل مشكلات الجودة فوراً. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال مراقبة الجودة أو مجال ذي صلة. فهم جيد للمخططات الهندسية ومواصفات البناء. معرفة بمعايير الجودة والسلامة في قطاع الإنشاءات. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات ممتازة في الملاحظة والتفاصيل. القدرة على إعداد التقارير الفنية بوضوح ودقة. مهارات تواصل وتنسيق فعالة مع مختلف الأطراف. القدرة على العمل بشكل مستقل وكجزء من فريق. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في الرياض. يتطلب العمل التواجد في مواقع المشاريع بشكل مستمر لضمان المراقبة الفعالة للجودة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا المنصب سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات بعد المقابلة.

6dec24d0c88101bb.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة ألفا لوكالة التأمين عن أخصائي تأمين للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية تنفيذ كافة الأعمال والعمليات التأمينية، وتقديم المشورة اللازمة، وضمان استيفاء المتطلبات الوثائقية، وإعداد التقارير المتخصصة. هذا الدور بدوام كامل ويتطلب خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية إعداد البيانات المتعلقة بالممتلكات والمعدات والمنشآت التابعة للجهة، وتحديد قيمها التأمينية، وتحديد الاحتياجات التأمينية تمهيداً لتنفيذها. دراسة وتحليل ومقارنة عروض شركات التأمين المختلفة لاختيار الأنسب منها، وتقديم التوصيات بشأنها، ومتابعة اعتمادها. تنفيذ العمليات والمشروعات والمبادرات المتخصصة في مجال التأمين، والتعاون مع الخبراء الاكتواريين لتحديد المخاطر وتطبيق النماذج الاكتوارية. تحليل المعلومات والبيانات لتحديد الحاجة إلى خدمات ومنتجات تأمينية جديدة، ومراقبة متطلبات واتجاهات التأمين، وتقديم نتائج التحليلات مع المبررات المنطقية للرئيس المباشر. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بالتأمين، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال التأمين. فهم شامل للعمليات التأمينية والمستندات المرتبطة بها. القدرة على تحليل عروض التأمين وتقديم توصيات مستنيرة. مهارات قوية في إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. بيئة العمل يعمل أخصائي التأمين ضمن فريق متخصص في شركة ألفا لوكالة التأمين في مدينة الرياض. يتطلب الدور التزاماً بالعمل بدوام كامل، مع التركيز على الدقة والاحترافية في جميع المهام الموكلة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذا الدور غير معلن وسيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات خلال عملية التوظيف.

Required Attributes Methodical and organized approach to work. Application Information This is a contract position based in Al Jubail, Saudi Arabia. Salary details will be disclosed during the application process.

Monitor marketing communications design schedules and provide progress reports. Ensure all delivered products and services adhere to company policies and standards. 6dbb6adbcaad201e.description: About the Role Talents Sea is seeking an Electrical Draftsman to join their team in Makkah, with work primarily located in Jeddah and Makkah. This full-time role involves preparing precise technical drawings, layouts, and detailed plans using computer-aided design (CAD) software. The successful candidate will collaborate with engineers, architects, and project teams to ensure drawings meet project specifications, standards, and deadlines. Role Overview The Electrical Draftsman will be responsible for creating and modifying a variety of technical drawings essential for project execution. This includes developing both 2D and 3D models, ensuring all designs comply with established standards and project requirements. The role requires close coordination with various stakeholders to maintain accuracy and timely delivery of documentation. Key Responsibilities Prepare and modify 2D technical drawings using AutoCAD. Develop 3D models and project visualizations using SketchUp. Prepare single-line diagrams (SLDs), shop drawings, and detailed construction drawings. Prepare as-built drawings and update drawings based on actual site conditions. Develop detailed drawings, layouts, plans, sections, and elevations based on engineering and architectural requirements. Revise drawings in accordance with project changes, design updates, and technical comments. Ensure drawings comply with company standards, project specifications, and applicable codes and standards. Review drawings for accuracy, dimensions, materials, annotations, and technical details. Coordinate with engineers, architects, site teams, and other project stakeholders to ensure accurate and timely drawing updates. 6d79c75231147d98.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مصنع الجزيره للدهانات عن أخصائي إدارة مشاريع للانضمام إلى فريقها في الرياض. يهدف هذا الدور بدوام كامل إلى دعم ومتابعة المشاريع المختلفة، مع التركيز على التخطيط الفعال وتنفيذ المهام لضمان سير العمليات بسلاسة وكفاءة. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تحليل عناصر وفعاليات المشروع، وتحديد ارتباطاتها وترتيبها، ودراسة قيمة المشروع وحجمه. إعداد برنامج زمني مفصل للمشروع وترتيب الإجراءات اللازمة لتنفيذه. تحديد الموارد المادية والبشرية المطلوبة لتنفيذ المشروع ومتابعة توفيرها في التوقيتات المناسبة. إعداد جدول تدفق نقدي يتناسب مع تسلسل تنفيذ فعاليات المشروع. مراجعة التنفيذ والتقدم الفعلي للمشروع ومقارنته بالبرنامج المخطط. إعداد البرامج المعدلة والمنقحة عند الضرورة، وتطوير أساليب وتقنيات العمل باستخدام التقنيات الحديثة. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بإدارة المشاريع. تقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وتوضيحها، وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال إدارة المشاريع أو ما يعادلها. القدرة على تحليل البيانات وتخطيط المشاريع بفعالية. مهارات ممتازة في إعداد التقارير والعروض التقديمية. القدرة على العمل ضمن فريق والتواصل بفعالية. بيئة العمل يقع مقر هذا الدور في الرياض، وهو وظيفة بدوام كامل ضمن فريق متخصص في مصنع الجزيره للدهانات. تلتزم الشركة بتوفير بيئة عمل داعمة تتيح للموظفين النمو المهني. معلومات إضافية هذه فرصة للانضمام إلى فريق عمل ديناميكي والمساهمة في إدارة مشاريع حيوية. لم يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الراتب في هذه المرحلة.

6dac35e887e8943d.description: About Alstom and the Talent Pool Alstom specializes in transport networks, offering a broad portfolio including high-speed trains, metros, monorails, trams, turnkey systems, services, infrastructure, signaling, and digital mobility solutions. The company connects cities globally, focusing on greener and smarter mobility. This Talent Pool is established to connect with professionals interested in future opportunities within Alstom in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, for upcoming full-time vacancies that align with their background and expertise. The Role of Deputy Project Director Alstom is seeking a Deputy Project Director to contribute to the delivery of rail solutions in Saudi Arabia. This senior leadership role involves working with teams to address complex challenges and ensure project success. The Deputy Project Director's decisions will influence future mobility initiatives and promote organizational excellence. Key Responsibilities Oversee large-scale project execution, ensuring scalability and sustainable growth in line with Alstom’s global standards. Foster cross-functional collaboration among engineering, operations, and client stakeholders to achieve seamless project integration. Implement robust processes to guarantee reliability, safety, and compliance across all project phases. Champion innovation by introducing advanced technologies and methodologies to optimize project outcomes. Promote knowledge sharing and mentorship, cultivating a culture of continuous improvement and leadership development. Performance Metrics On-time delivery of project milestones and achievement of strategic objectives. Effective collaboration and leadership across multidisciplinary teams. Reduction in project defects, enhanced efficiency, and proactive troubleshooting. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 10 years of experience in a relevant field. Demonstrated ability to lead and collaborate with committed teams on complex challenges. Experience in ensuring seamless integration of business and technology. Work Environment and Development This role offers the opportunity to work with rail technology and contribute to Alstom’s strategic vision from the Saudi Arabia office in Riyadh. Professionals can advance their careers through continuous learning, leadership development, and exposure to international best practices. Alstom is committed to creating an inclusive workplace and is an equal-opportunity employer operating in 63 countries.

6d1c5d95bc8bbd21.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل عن مدرب مهني للانضمام إلى فريقها في مكة المكرمة. يركز هذا الدور بدوام كامل على إعداد وتنفيذ خطط التدريس والتدريب العملي في مجال التخصص، مع متابعة وتقييم أداء المتدربين. الهدف من الوظيفة الهدف الأساسي لهذا الدور هو إعداد خطط تدريس نظرية وعملية متكاملة في حقل التخصص، والإشراف على تجهيز وتشغيل معامل وورش التدريب. كما يتضمن الدور تدريس المواد النظرية، والتدريب على الجوانب العملية والتطبيقية، وتقييم أداء المتدربين وتحصيلهم، بالإضافة إلى إعداد وحفظ الوثائق والتقارير المتعلقة بتقدمهم. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية دراسة وتحليل مناهج علوم المهنة والتدريب المهني في مجال التخصص وتحديد الأهداف التعليمية المباشرة. إعداد قوائم مستلزمات معامل أو ورش التدريب، بما في ذلك الكميات والمواصفات، وتركيب وتشغيل التجهيزات. إعداد خطط تدريس المادة النظرية، وتصميم واختيار واستخدام التقنيات التربوية وأساليب التدريس الفعالة. تنفيذ وإدارة الدروس النظرية، وتصميم الاختبارات النظرية، وقياس تحصيل المتدربين. إعداد خطط الدروس والتطبيقات العملية، وتنفيذها وإدارتها، وتنظيم التطبيقات العملية والميدانية للمتدربين. تصميم الاختبارات العملية وقياس أداء المتدربين. تطوير أساليب التدريس وأدوات القياس والتقويم، ومواكبة التطور العلمي والتقني في مجال الاختصاص. إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتعلقة بأداء المتدربين وتحصيلهم الدراسي وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة تتراوح من 0 إلى 1 سنة في مجال التدريب المهني أو التعليم الفني. القدرة على إعداد وتطوير المناهج التدريبية النظرية والعملية. مهارات ممتازة في التدريس والتواصل والتقييم. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة مكة المكرمة، وتتطلب الالتزام ببيئة عمل ديناميكية تركز على تطوير المهارات المهنية للمتدربين. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى فريق شركة زهران للصيانه والتشغيل، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم.

6dcc6eff088eeb16.description: About the Internship Panda Retail Company – Savola Group is offering a Project Management internship opportunity in Makkah and Jeddah. This internship is designed for individuals seeking to gain practical experience in project management within a retail environment. The program is an entry-level position, suitable for candidates with 0-1 years of experience. Program Overview This internship falls under the Tamheer program, which aims to provide Saudi nationals with on-the-job training and development. Participants will be exposed to various aspects of project management, contributing to real-world projects and enhancing their professional skills within a structured learning environment. Key Requirements for Tamheer Program Eligibility Applicants must be Saudi nationals. Candidates should not have been registered with GOSI for a minimum period of six months prior to application. A bachelor's degree is required for this program. Applicants must not have been previously registered under the Tamheer program. Location and Work Type This internship is available in the cities of Jeddah and Makkah. It is a full-time internship position, providing comprehensive exposure to the company's operations and project methodologies. The salary for this position will be disclosed during the interview process. Application Process Interested candidates who meet the specified Tamheer requirements are encouraged to apply. Further details regarding the application process will be provided upon initial contact.

6d90979b2b129f94.description: About the Role Marriott International is seeking a Demi Chef De Partie for a full-time position in Jeddah. This role involves preparing and cooking food items according to established recipes, quality standards, and presentation guidelines. The Demi Chef De Partie will ensure proper portioning, arrangement, and garnishing of food, while also monitoring food quality and quantity. Key Responsibilities Prepare special meals or substitute items as required. Regulate the temperature of ovens, broilers, grills, and roasters. Manage food thawing processes from freezer storage to refrigeration. Maintain accurate food logs and ensure adherence to food preparation checklists. Communicate staffing needs during peak periods and inform the Chef of excess food items for daily specials. Notify Food & Beverage service staff about menu specials and out-of-stock items. Prepare and cook both hot and cold food items, ensuring consistent quality. Team Leadership and Operational Support Assist management with hiring, training, scheduling, evaluating, counseling, disciplining, and motivating employees. Serve as a role model for team members and support the team in achieving common goals. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with colleagues. Listen and respond appropriately to employee concerns. Compliance and Safety Adhere to all company, safety, and security policies and procedures. Report maintenance needs, accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to management. Complete all required safety training and certifications. Ensure a clean and professional uniform and personal appearance. Maintain confidentiality of proprietary information and protect company assets. Ensure adherence to quality expectations and standards in all tasks. Physical Requirements and Guest Service Anticipate and address guests’ service needs with clear and professional communication. Ability to stand, sit, or walk for extended periods. Capable of reaching overhead and below the knees, including bending, twisting, pulling, and stooping. Ability to move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing up to 25 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors. Qualifications and Experience Education: A Technical, Trade, or Vocational School Degree is preferred. Experience: At least 3 years of related work experience is required. The role requires 2-5 years of overall experience. Supervisory Experience: No supervisory experience is required for this position.

6d92d551eb995154.description: About the Role Acwa is seeking a Shift Charge Engineer to oversee overall plant operation activities during their shift. This full-time position is based in Al Qassim, Al Qasim, and requires ensuring all plant activities are performed safely and efficiently, adhering to approved Standard Operating Procedures, quality standards, and time schedules. Key Responsibilities Comply with all safety rules and regulations, maintaining full awareness of plant safety hazards. Ensure plant operation meets established standards, minimizing risks to personnel, machinery, and materials, and adhering to safety and environmental standards. Coordinate all plant operation-related activities with other departments during the shift. Possess a complete understanding of the plant's permit-to-work system, issuing and canceling permits as authorized. Follow operational schedules to achieve targeted production availability safely and efficiently, coordinating all plant status changes with the Operations Manager. Make prompt decisions to correct abnormalities or disturbances and take corrective actions during emergencies. Supervise start-up checklists, interlock checks, protection tests, and non-routine activities such as preservation or acid cleaning. Monitor the overall plant status, summarize activities in the log book, and prepare daily plant status reports. Prepare incident/accident reports and other required departmental reports, submitting them within stipulated timeframes. Assist in the training and familiarization of new personnel within the shift. Study and propose modifications to improve plant efficiency. Ensure Environmental Aspect-Impact and Hazard Risk Assessments are conducted, controlled, and updated. Implement, monitor, and report on Integrated Management System (IMS) objectives, targets, and programs. Report deviations in the IMS, identify root causes, and implement corrective and preventive actions. Ensure regulatory compliance for all activities within their scope. Identify competency gaps for subordinate personnel and implement necessary actions, including providing on-the-job training and evaluating performance. Identify, document, and control hazards in the assigned work area. Control emergencies, incidents, and near misses. Communicate effectively with the Load Dispatch Center. Qualifications and Experience A minimum of 5-10 years of experience in a relevant field. Familiarity with plant O&M agreements, P&IDs, SOPs, Work Instructions, Operation and control logics, emergency operation procedures, and regulatory requirements. Ability to supervise and coordinate activities effectively. Work Environment The successful candidate must be prepared to work in a remote location.
